facts.fact: In a written parliamentary reply of 4 September 2026 the Minister of Public Service and Administration described the Batho Pele AI Chatbot as successfully implemented, helping public servants find policies, directives and procedures faster, and said it could be scaled across government in phases.

facts.fact: The Minister's written reply of 4 September 2026 says the Department is working on Data Quality and Data Classification Guidelines for the Public Service, alongside a Determination and Directive on Public Service Data Management and a Directive on the Public Service Data Architecture Framework.
